title: DENR: Unauthorized Spartan Trail hikers to face legal consequences

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in Central Visayas will pursue available administrative and legal remedies against individuals found responsible for entering the closed Spartan Trail without authorization. The Central Cebu Protected Landscape–Protected Area Management Office (CCPL-PAMO) said violations will be documented, investigated, and referred for appropriate administrative and […]...
